mechanics.name: Potential Energy
mechanics.currentEffect: While repairing a Generator, press Active Ability to store Potential Energy: repair charges no longer progress that Generator and instead yield 1 Token per equivalent 1% progression, up to 10/15/20. A failed Repair Skill Check below the token cap removes 20% of accumulated Tokens; a failed check at the cap regresses the Generator by 10%. With at least one Token, press Active Ability again on the same or another Generator to spend all Tokens and instantly progress that Generator by 1% per Token. The perk deactivates after use or losing a Health State; losing a Health State also removes all stored Tokens.
activation: Be repairing a Generator and press Active Ability to store progress as Tokens.
Have at least one Token and press Active Ability on a Generator to spend the stored Tokens.
Ends/deactivates when: Deactivates after spending Tokens.
Ends/deactivates when: Losing any Health State deactivates the perk and removes all accumulated Tokens.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.1.0): Removed the minimum repair time to activate, changed the conversion to 1% repair progress per Token, and set the cap to 10/15/20 Tokens by tier.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: It converts Generator repair into capped tokens that can be spent as instant progress on another Generator, but is lost after use or taking damage.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Gain 1 Token per 1% equivalent repair progression, up to 10/15/20. Below the cap, a failed Repair Skill Check removes 20% of accumulated Tokens; at the cap, a failed check regresses the Generator by 10% instead. Spending Tokens consumes all of them, each yielding 1% instant Generator progression. Losing a Health State removes all Tokens.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: The perk deactivates after use or losing any Health State, so it cannot be used again in that Trial after either event.
specialInteractions: Token charge rate is affected by repair-speed effects and Generator repair progression bonuses, including Great Skill Check bonus progression.

editorial.summary: Store up to 20% worth of repair as Tokens instead of progressing the current generator, then dump those Tokens into another generator later; taking damage loses the stored Tokens.
useCases: Move progress from a safe generator into a dangerous central or 3-gen-breaking objective.
Bank objective value before rotating to a generator the Killer is heavily defending.
Coordinate a sudden burst completion in SWF.
counters: Taking damage deletes all stored Tokens.
While storing, the current generator is not advancing normally.
Poor macro decisions can simply move progress around without creating a net advantage.
pros: Unique ability to transfer repair effort between generators.
cons: Risk of losing all stored value.
analysis: Potential Energy earns this position because its value is strategic rather than numerical. The perk does not create free repair speed; it lets the Survivor decide where their repair investment eventually lands.

That becomes useful against dangerous generator clusters. A Survivor can work safely elsewhere, store Tokens, then rotate into the contested generator and inject progress before the Killer has time to fully respond.

The entire mechanic is punished by taking damage. Losing twenty stored Tokens can erase a large chunk of personal tempo, so the user must understand Killer position and choose the transfer window carefully.

SWF can exploit Potential Energy much better because the team can coordinate when a burst completion matters. In ordinary Solo Q it is easier to overcomplicate a situation that simple generator repair would have solved.
editorial.verdict: A clever anti-3-gen and burst-progress tool, not a repair-speed perk. Potential Energy rewards macro planning and punishes greed brutally.
